title: Single-source the explanation-activation cross-check; audit gate lacks ship's belt
body: Architecture review 2026-09-01 (HIGH, PR #518): explanationdocs.CycleBinding is hand-assembled at 4 sites from 4 carriers (core.CycleState, core.ReviewInput, ship.Options, audit.PhaseRequest); ContractVersion==0 encodes BOTH 'legacy cycle' and 'caller dropped the field'. Ship has an explicit belt (native_explanation_gate.go:54-69 cross-checks typed identity vs host activation marker); audit has none — version 0 in => active=false => return nil, silently disabling the gate. Fix the CLASS: extract ONE exported activation cross-check into explanationdocs (single home) called by BOTH ship and audit; or constructors returning Active(version)/Legacy() (Null Object) so exemption is constructed deliberately. Do not copy ship's belt into audit (that duplicates the belief).
